title: Bench2Dex: Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across Dexterous Hands
abstract: arXiv:2609.15726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tactile sensing provides contact information that can be difficult to infer from vision alone, but tactile hardware for dexterous hands has not converged to a common design. Dexterous hands differ in finger structure, contact surfaces, and sensor layouts, while simulated tactile signals still differ from measurements produced by physical sensors. These factors make it difficult to study visuo-tactile manipulation across diverse dexterous hands within a consistent experimental setting. We adapt existing robot models with a shared simulated tactile interface that converts local contact geometry into image-like tactile observations. translated_title: Bench2Dex：跨多种灵巧手的视觉-触觉双手灵巧操作基准测试
translated_abstract: 触觉感知能够提供仅凭视觉难以推断的接触信息，但用于灵巧手的触觉硬件尚未形成统一的设计标准。不同灵巧手在手指结构、接触表面和传感器布局上各不相同，而模拟生成的触觉信号与物理传感器实际测量结果之间仍然存在差异。这些因素使得在一致的实验环境下研究跨多种灵巧手的视觉-触觉操作变得十分困难。我们提出了Bench2Dex，一个面向12种灵巧手的视觉-触觉双手操作仿真基准。我们对现有机器人模型进行了适配，采用一个共享的模拟触觉接口，将局部接触几何信息转换为图像式的触觉观测。该接口在不同手部形态之间提供了统一的观测格式，而无需尝试复现某个特定物理触觉传感器的输出。Bench2Dex包含26个双手操作任务……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Bench2Dex，一个覆盖12种灵巧手的视觉-触觉双手操作仿真基准，通过统一的模拟触觉接口将接触几何转换为图像式触觉观测，从而在一致的实验设置下实现跨不同手部形态的对比研究。
en_tdlr: Bench2Dex is a simulation benchmark for visuo-tactile bimanual dexterous manipulation across 12 dexterous hands, featuring a unified simulated tactile interface that converts local contact geometry into image-like tactile observations for consistent cross-hand experimentation.
